
Use svg for html files.
change width/height in the svg file for best results.
Or can do this:
inkscape --actions="page-fit-to-selection" -o RFAxM1.svg RFAxM1.svg
inkscape --actions="export-area-drawing;export-margin:10" -o output.svg input.svg



svg2tikz --figonly test.svg > test.tex


use render to get the html files:
quarto render --to html

quarto publish gh-pages

latex testsvg.tex
dvisvgm testsvg.dvi
